title: Destin Excursions

services.name: Dolphin Adventure
services.desc: Scenic boat cruise from Fort Walton Beach across Choctawhatchee Bay toward Destin. For all ages! • 2-4 hours • Enjoy a day on the water watching the local dolphins play!

services.name: Sunrise Tour
services.desc: Short scenic boat cruise from Fort Walton Beach across Choctawhatchee Bay to the Destin area with on-deck viewing. For all ages! • 2-4 Hours • Join us for a beautiful Destin Sunrise!

services.name: Sunset Tour
services.desc: A short, scenic daytime boat cruise from Fort Walton Beach across Choctawhatchee Bay to the Destin area with on-deck views and a relaxed atmosphere. For all ages! • 2-4 Hours • Join us for a beautiful tour as the sun goes down!

services.name: Fishing Trip
services.desc: Short, scenic boat cruise from Fort Walton Beach across Choctawhatchee Bay to the Destin area with relaxed on-deck viewing. For all ages! • 3-6 hours • Chasing the big ones!

includes: Licensed and insured boat for up to 6 passengers
blurb: Guests join private charters aboard the Miss Clarissa, licensed and insured for up to 6 passengers. Trips include dolphin cruises, snorkeling adventures, and sunset cruises on the emerald-green waters of Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay. The captain is friendly and professional, and the cruises can be customized to fit the group's needs.
extraNote: Private charters only, your party only on the boat · If you don't want to be around other boats or people, specify to the captain when booking · Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. · Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · Thank you for booking with Destin Excursions! We look forward to having you aboard!
